_about: Rudyard Kipling's (1865-1936) books for children that the relay named: the two Jungle Books, the Just So Stories, and the two Puck books (Puck of Pook's Hill and its sequel Rewards and Fairies). Clean Gutenberg text; all published before 1930: US public domain. Kipling died in 1936, so these are still in copyright in life+70 and life+80 countries; this shelf records US status only. His other books are listed below as pending, for Adam to decide.
